newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine farm group says wheat damaged by storms.
newsitem.headline: Argentine farm group says wheat damaged by storms.

text.p: Argentina's main farm lobby said Friday that large zones of the country's wheat crop have been damaged by storms and hail.

The Rural Society announced it felt "extreme concern over the economic losses suffered by producers in different areas of the provinces of La Pampa, Buenos Aires and Cordoba due to climatic adversity suffered recently."

But traders played down output losses. One told Reuters, "We're still arguing whether output will be 15.5 million or 16 million tonnes. So the margin of error over crop estimates is a bigger unknown than whether 200,000 tonnes have been lost."

But the Rural Society said, "The intense rain which has fallen in recent hours, accompanied by an unusual hail storm that affected a vast zone of the aforementioned provinces will push agricultural businesses to bankruptcy."
It called on the government to act swiftly to assess the damage and aid producers in affected zones.
Expecting a bumper crop, Argentina's wheat exporters have been perhaps the major factor in world markets in recent weeks.
